scope: Public-code-and-receipt inventory only; no live cloud inspection or row-level verification in this file.

old_full_base.typed_leaf_semantics: ad_status has canonical locator and engineering state; experience and technology contain sparse candidate evidence; v6_audit is selected sparse qualification/education audit evidence. None is a complete normalized-text or certified fine-semantic table.

old_full_narrow.boundary: Old-version candidate measurements; engineering usable does not mean semantic accuracy. Occupation/task prior experience is structurally unavailable, and nondetection is not a semantic negative.

hash_meanings.exact_text_sha256: SHA-256 of original full advertisement text, UTF-8
hash_meanings.normalized_context_sha256: SHA-256 of the complete frozen-normalized text, UTF-8; normalization must use the pinned legacy_v5_frozen.py implementation

fixed10k_reference.exact_reuse_rule: Join a canonical ad directly on the full four-part key only for its own reference; transfer a field judgment to another ad only after exact raw full-text equality or identical complete frozen-normalized input, preserving field-specific status, provenance, and unknown/conflict mask. Hash equality is a candidate identity check; compare full input when available. JOB_HASH alone and similar/partial text are insufficient.

existing_exact_key_bridge.meaning: A previous additive pass joined old V6 audit, old narrow and newer rule outputs by the four-part canonical key, checked manifest-listed file hashes, and kept version-specific fields separate.
existing_exact_key_bridge.scope_boundary: That frozen 69-shard convenience wave is evidence of an interface, not a complete 2464-shard overlay or fine-semantic coverage.

failed_prediction_status.rule: Frozen CPU predictions are candidate sidecars only and cannot fill reference fields or unknowns.

not_verified_here: Current cloud existence, accessibility and SHA-256 of every reported private asset, including the latest Batch069 ledger and the old typed-root files.
A row-level exact correspondence between all fixed10k keys and the 2464-shard old V6/narrow base; public receipts do not provide a complete map.

Whether the old V6 typed rows retain a raw or complete-normalized text hash: the published frozen typed and narrow schemas list the four-part key but no such hash. A valid text-identity bridge would need the retained source text and pinned normalization, checked against the fixed10k frame.
Any overlay coverage count, correctness rate, or compatibility of old candidate values with new reference field semantics.
overlay_boundary: Keep old V6 and narrow files immutable. Write independently versioned, field-specific corrections only for verified exact ads or complete-input matches. Preserve all original values and unknown states; leave unmatched ads unchanged and disable failed prediction fields.
